AFFECT /qt/qml/xofm/libs/homescreen/qml/CreateMenu.qml
	TRAVERSE Item#root
		LOCATE BEFORE ALL
		INSERT{
			signal favClicked
			signal tagClicked
		}

		TRAVERSE Rectangle#primaryContainer > RowLayout#primaryLayout
			LOCATE BEFORE ALL 
			INSERT {
			Action {
                id: favBut
                Layout.alignment: Qt.AlignHCenter
                    Layout.fillHeight: true
                    Layout.minimumWidth: root.iconSize
                    
				currentView: root.view
				popupOverlay: root.popupOverlay
				anchorTarget: root
				supportedViews: ["myfiles", "filter", "notebook-filter"]
				onActionClicked: root.favClicked()
                visible: favBut.supportedViews.includes(root.view)
                iconSource: "qrc:/ark/icons/star"
            }
			Action {
                id: tagBut
                Layout.alignment: Qt.AlignHCenter
                    Layout.fillHeight: true
                    Layout.minimumWidth: root.iconSize
                    
				currentView: root.view
				popupOverlay: root.popupOverlay
				anchorTarget: root
				supportedViews: ["myfiles", "filter", "notebook-filter"]
				onActionClicked: root.tagClicked()
                visible: tagBut.supportedViews.includes(root.view)
                iconSource: "qrc:/ark/icons/tag"
            }
			
			}
		END TRAVERSE
		
	END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT


AFFECT /qml/device/view/navigator/Navigator.qml
	TRAVERSE FocusScope#root > HomeScreen.CreateMenu#createMenu 
		LOCATE AFTER ALL
		INSERT {
		onFavClicked: { root.openExplorer( ViewManager.View.Favorites)}
		onTagClicked: { root.openExplorer( ViewManager.View.Tags)}
		}
	END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT
